title: Import Tool Brief
lede: Answer what you care about. Skip the rest and I will pick a sane default. Press Send answers to Claude when you are done.

questions.title: What happens to a row the parser cannot read?
questions.why: The sample file holds 38 rows with a broken date. The choice here decides whether an import can ever half-succeed.

options.label: Stop the whole import
options.note: Safest. One bad row costs you the run.

options.label: Skip the row and log it
options.note: The import finishes. You must read the log to learn what you lost.

options.label: Import the row with the field left empty
options.note: Nothing is lost. Bad data reaches the database.

questions.placeholder: e.g. stop only when more than 1 percent of rows fail

questions.title: Which source formats must work on day one?
questions.why: Each format is about a day of work. Pick as many as you want.

options.label: CSV
options.note: The format your samples already use.

options.label: Excel
options.note: Needs a third-party reader and its own tests.

options.label: JSON
options.note: Cheapest to add. Nobody has asked for it yet.

options.label: Fixed-width text
options.note: The bank export. Needs a column map per source.
